task_goal: Land on the pad at (0,0) with legs in contact, minimizing time and fuel use.
state_space: 8-dim: normalized x, y, linear velocities (x,y), angle, angular velocity, two leg contact booleans.
action_space: Discrete: 0=do nothing, 1=fire left orientation engine, 2=fire main engine, 3=fire right orientation engine.
termination_modes: Lander not awake (state becomes stationary without ground contact).
success_like_ending: Both legs in contact with ground (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Lander position near (0,0) (state[0] and state[1] close to 0).
Low linear and angular velocities at touchdown.
Episode termination without crash or out-of-bounds.
failure_like_endings: Lander not awake (state becomes stationary without ground contact).
behavior_trajectory_prior: Phase 1: Stabilize and descend toward pad vicinity using main engine and orientation corrections.
Phase 2: Fine-tune horizontal position and vertical velocity for soft landing on pad.
Phase 3: Touch down with both legs on pad, zero velocity, upright orientation.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely at safe altitude without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing off-pad but with legs down (avoids crash but misses primary objective).
Excessive orientation engine use causing oscillation or fuel waste without progress.
